pattern: SELECT .+ FROM (.*?) JOIN (.*) ON (.*?) JOIN (.*) ON (.*?) WHERE Year >= '(.*?)' GROUP BY Stadium_Name, Capacity ORDER BY COUNT\(*\) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: SELECT T2.\<desired_column\> , T2.\<desired_capacity_column\> FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id WHERE T1.year >= \<desired_year\> GROUP BY T2.\<desired_stadium_id_column\> ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that has an unnecessary join to an unrelated table and incorrectly groups by non-aggregated columns.
